{{PAGENAME}}s can be turned into [[science]] or used in the crafting of [[sermons]] and [[Stone prayer station|stone prayer stations]]. Books, unlike most other items, completely change sprite depending on quality level. With all {{Quality|copper}} books appearing to have a [[softcover]] even when crafted with a [[hard cover]] and vice versa for {{Quality|silver}} and {{Quality|gold}} quality books. Since book crafting is wholly dependent on the quality of ingredients, plus the bonuses from [[desk II]] and jeweler perk, there are no set recipes in regards to quality on the end product.

[[Writing]] is a good source of {{Techpoint|Blue}}, as most products yield a few of them. 

'''Note:''' There is also a {{item|ruined book}}, which can be recycled for some [[clean paper|paper]], but is not described here.
